role: Private reasoning episode executor mediating between triggers and external responses via graph queries
detail: Implements a four-phase symbolic reasoning cycle (decompose, resolve, validate, decide) that processes incoming triggers through graph-based definition/classification/inference queries, tracks reasoning as first-class graph artifacts per CANON A.19, and produces inner-register conclusions for PT-11 translation. Key classes: InnerMonologueExecutor (main coordinator), ReasoningResult (episode outcome with symbolic traces and step summaries), SymbolicTrace (computable reasoning phase record, not text), ReasoningStepSummary (lightweight step view for transparency). Convergence detection: terminates when confidence change < CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD (0.02) for CONVERGENCE_WINDOW (2) consecutive steps, or at MAX_STEPS (5) hard limit, or on no_evidence. Pure graph-reasoning component with no LLM calls; all reasoning via graph queries; external register translation deferred to PT-11.
gotchas: Symbolic decomposer must exist and not fail silently; grounding_maintenance required or clarify action fires always; comprehension_ratio=0.0 indicates cold-start MEANS edges; inner_speech stored but never shown to guardian; activation patterns only populated if decomposer succeeds; outer register (external_text) empty until PT-11 translation applied by caller; no LLM error handling expected as component is pure graph-based; convergence window may short-circuit before depth_limit if confidence plateaus early
